reading: The vehicle-time relaxation (R3) never bound on any of the 40 days: its bound is never strictly tighter than the energy bound, so the reported upper bound equals the energy relaxation everywhere and R3 did not influence any number in the registered result.
construction_caveat: R3 as implemented sums one out-and-back trip per served order. That quantity is an UPPER bound on the time a chained route needs, not a lower bound, so if R3 had ever been the binding relaxation the result would not have been a valid upper bound. R3 never bound, so the registered numbers are unaffected; R3 must not be relied on in this form.
valid_tightening_directions: a rigorous per-order lower bound on the whole segment energy (pre-cooling plus door recovery plus the minimum cooling for the direct depot-order-depot trip) derived from coldchain_state._advance_temperatures, which with all three zones active gives at least (0.30*0.143 + 1.80*0.714 + 3.20*0.860) kWh per hour of segment time
a joint time-window and fleet relaxation that keeps the coupling R1 and R3 drop separately
